author: thaddea
body:
Hey!
I'm Thaddea, and would like to request a ban repeal. I was banned for hacking over two years ago (March 8 2014).
I don't have any hacks, i don't download anything from the internet because i don't want to ruin my computer with viruses. Obviously if im appealing two years after the event of getting banned you can tell i really like your server and want to play it again, and i feel like i've waited out the sentence prescribed to me for an adequate amount of time.
The ban number is: 65725
Thank you for your consideration!
Hope to hear back from you soon!
-thaddea
